purpose: Verify two policy coverage fixes and conservative date handling against baseline regressions and separate new holdout cases.
source_of_truth: The complete fictional records, import rules, source_notes and gold_cells in cases.json. Labels were authored before live calls. These are not independently annotated real-world datasets.
model_context: Normal production investigation receives aggregate counts and candidate references. Optional value assistance receives only affected cell values and relevant JSON rules. Gold labels and source_notes are withheld.

cohorts.declared_rules: Four cases, including a clean control, date convention exception, exact aliases and multiple affected records.
cohorts.semantic_repairs: Four cases requiring meaningful country-text normalization beyond declared aliases.
cohorts.exception_knowledge: Four cases with unknown facts, an impossible date, excluded country and ambiguous country/identity conflicts.
cohorts.source_coverage: Two baseline probes, now with the formerly omitted requirements explicitly encoded using the new rule types.
cohorts.fresh_holdout: Four new cases: email multi-item, inclusive policy boundaries and nonmatching control, impossible April date, declared day-first conversion.

metrics.missed_issues: Expected (record, field, issue kind) tuples absent from local validation, divided by independently listed expected issues. The engine is the issue detector; do not attribute this recall to the LLM.
metrics.false_positive_issues: Observed issue tuples not present in the oracle. Report counts and the clean control separately.
metrics.rule_candidate_selection: Correct rule-backed changes selected by the live investigator divided by independently checked expected deterministic candidates.
metrics.incorrect_suggestions: Raw or delivered suggested values that disagree with an answerable gold value, plus any proposed value for a must-abstain cell. Divide by the number of suggestions in that phase. A lucky unsupported guess remains an error.
metrics.all_incorrect_or_unsupported_suggestions: For the user-facing factual-quality total, add incorrect_suggestions and hypothesis_truth_mismatch, then divide by all suggestions. Keep these disjoint subtypes visible so a permissible but factually wrong date hypothesis is not hidden by a zero contract-error rate.
metrics.unnecessary_refusals: Explicit abstentions on answerable value targets divided by all answerable value targets. Transport failures, malformed responses and missing items are separate availability/coverage failures, not refusals.
metrics.hypothesis_truth_mismatch: Suggestions on ambiguous dates that disagree with the hidden fixture ledger. Report separately: a permitted, labeled hypothesis can be factually wrong without violating the suggestion contract.
metrics.item_coverage: Number of requested cells with a response item; inspect raw and delivered output independently and retain malformed/fallback events.
metrics.reviewed_outcome: For repairable fixtures, both scripted approvals, exact oracle output and preserved original are required. For hold fixtures, becoming approval-ready is a failure even if the evaluator withholds approval. This is human-assisted harness completion, not autonomous accuracy.

design_limits: One initial pass per case; no repeated-run reliability estimate.
Small, deliberately constructed suite; rates are descriptive and do not establish generalization.
CSV is used to isolate reasoning and rule coverage; format parser tests remain a separate offline evidence set.
No research-paper or CMS QA results are pooled with this suite.
Store every run, including failures; any targeted retry is reported separately, never substituted silently.
Live operation requires explicit --live --consent-synthetic. All jobs stay in ignored tmp storage and never touch saved user reviews.
Production changes respond to the baseline findings. The four new cases were labeled before this live run; the repeated baseline cases are regressions, not unseen evidence.
changes_from_baseline: 14 baseline regression cases (two now encode previously omitted policies), plus four new fictional holdout cases labeled before live calls. Not independently annotated. Baseline date case now requires abstention rather than a hypothesis.
Email syntax and conditional date requirements must be encoded in rules. Omitted policy is not inferred.
Expected deterministic candidates are independently enumerated in the corpus.
120-request limit; raw responses and app-filtered responses scored separately; no overwriting baseline.
Keep fresh_holdout separate from the four regression cohorts.
